英語文 · 國三下學期 · 章節筆記

跨文本圖表閱讀與素養克漏字

Literacy reading in CAP exams requires synthesizing multimodal texts: bus timetables, weather forecasts, product packaging, infographics, and email notices. Strategies include: skimming the title and layout for the communicative purpose, scanning for specific numbers/times/conditions, and identifying context clues (synonyms, antonyms, transition words like however/therefore) to solve cloze passages.

章節重點

Skimming 略讀大意
快速閱讀文章首尾段、每段首句與小標題，掌握核心主題與主旨Read topic sentences first to capture the main idea before details.
Scanning 掃讀細節
帶著關鍵字（數字、專有名詞、年代）在文章與圖表中定位具體資訊Search for specific data, dates, or keywords without reading every word.
Graphic Interpretation 圖表判讀
對照文章段落論點與長條圖/表格數據，檢核文字論據是否吻合Verify whether chart trends support the author’s hypothesis or conclusion.

示範與推理

原創資料：A 館週一至週六 09:00–17:00，學生票 80 元；B 館每天 12:00–20:00，學生票 100 元。郵件說：「We can go only after 6 p.m. on Sunday, and each of us has $120.」應選哪館？

  1. 先整理限制：星期日、晚上六點後、每人不超過 120 元；三個條件都要滿足。
  2. A 館即使便宜，也因星期日不開且平日只到五點而不符合。B 館星期日營業到八點，100 元在預算內，所以可選 B。
  3. 若寫回信，可說 We should choose Museum B because it is open on Sunday evening and the student ticket is within our budget.。

易錯提醒　Do not assume information not present in the text; always verify eligibility conditions, time limits, and discounts carefully before answering.

闔上筆記，試著回想

  1. Read the notice: "Museum Open: Tue-Sun 9 a.m. - 5 p.m. Closed on Mondays. Free admission on the first Sunday of every month." Which visitor gets free entry?
    • A．A visitor arriving on any Monday morning
    • B．A student visiting on the first Sunday of May
    • C．A tourist visiting on a regular Friday afternoon
    • D．A visitor arriving on Sunday evening at 6 p.m.
  2. Create a bilingual English poster for an imaginary campus charity fair, including date, ticket price tiers, location, and contact email.
參考解答與自評

第 1 題　B（A student visiting on the first Sunday of May）。The notice states admission is free on the first Sunday of every month during opening hours.

第 2 題　用上方的章節重點自評。寫出答案，標明依據，並核對所用條件、單位或情境是否適合。
